$x≈$
{{field-1}}${}^{∘}$, $\,x≈$
{{field-2}}${}^{∘}$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we find the principal value:

$$
x=\operatorname{arcsin}⁡(0.85)=58.211\,669…≈{58.2117}^{∘}.
$$

Since ${58.2117}^{∘}$ lies inside the given domain, our first solution is ${x}_{1}={58.2117}^{∘}.$

Our first solution lies in the first quadrant and has a reference angle of ${\theta }_{R}={58.2117}^{∘}.$ Since $\operatorname{sin}⁡x>0,$ the second solution must lie in the second quadrant, and it also has a reference angle ${\theta }_{R}={58.2117}^{∘}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13992768/assets/ec4366c4e46cc9c1df5fb31aa2ca04f337fd3c6d0bce034405ca2b48874aa32a.png)

Since the second solution ${x}_{2}$ lies in the $2$nd quadrant, we can find it using the reference angle as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & ={180}^{∘}-{\theta }_{R} \\  & ={180}^{∘}-{58.2117}^{∘} \\  & ≈{121.7883}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

So, in ascending order, rounded to one decimal place, the solutions are 

$$
x≈{58.2}^{∘},\,x≈{121.8}^{∘}.
$$
